user: And the FX spread if I pay in USD?
answer:
For a Tier 1 account, the FX spread is **1.5%** over the mid-market rate. It applies only after your free monthly conversion allowance of **EUR 500** is used up.

Card payments also carry a **1.2%** fee, calculated on the EUR equivalent of the amount. The knowledge base doesn't say whether the FX spread and the card fee stack on the same USD payment, so I can't give a combined figure from the documentation alone.

I can't see how much of your EUR 500 allowance you've already used this month, and I don't have the current EUR/USD mid-market rate. If you tell me the amount, I can run a full quote showing the mid rate, spread, allowance and final amount.

fragments.text:
Verta tariff schedule
## FX spreads by tier
The spread is applied over the mid-market rate only after the free monthly
conversion allowance is exhausted.

| Tier | FX spread | Free monthly conversion allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Tier 1 | 1.5% | EUR 500 |
| Tier 2 | 0.9% | EUR 1,000 |
| Tier 3 | 0.5% | EUR 5,000 |

Fee details
## Card payment fee
Card payments carry a percentage fee on the EUR equivalent. No flat fee
applies.

Verta tariff schedule
## Transfer fees by type
| Transfer type | Flat fee | Percentage fee |
|---|---|---|
| Internal | EUR 0.00 | 0% |
| SEPA | EUR 0.35 | 0% |
| SWIFT | EUR 15.00 | 0.3% |
| Card payment | EUR 0.00 | 1.2% |

The percentage fee is calculated on the EUR equivalent of the transfer amount.

Transfer limits
## Daily and monthly limits by tier
Outgoing transfer limits are tracked in EUR equivalent, separately per day and
per calendar month. The daily and the monthly remainder are different numbers:
both are computed from the same settled-transactions source, but over
different windows.

| Tier | Daily limit | Monthly limit |
|---|---|---|
| Tier 1 | EUR 5,000 | EUR 50,000 |
| Tier 2 | EUR 20,000 | EUR 200,000 |
| Tier 3 | EUR 100,000 | EUR 1,000,000 |
